remarks: Discover the perfect blend of country living, recreation, and investment with this 36.3 acre property featuring approx. 841’ of frontage (approx. 270' to 400' deep at the road) and extending nearly 2,000’ to the rear line. This versatile parcel offers endless possibilities. You could sell off a few lots and still have plenty of land for your own dream home, hobby farm, or private retreat. The land includes approx.. 9.5 acres of hardwood forest at the back, ideal for hunting, recreation, selective logging, or as a natural backdrop. With its open acreage, good soil, and level terrain, the property is well suited for farming or agricultural use. Grow crops, raise animals, or create your own farm in a peaceful rural setting. Enjoy creek access directly across from the frontage, adding to the property’s natural charm and outdoor appeal.
